mergedParams.userDescription: UI elements window closing loading bar transition effects between videos

output.title: Video Transition Effects & UI Loading Elements

prompts.prompt: Create a UI window closing transition preset that simulates a desktop application window minimizing with a loading bar progress indicator. The outgoing video should scale down and slide towards the bottom-right corner (like minimizing to taskbar) while fading out over 0.8 seconds. During this transition, show a thin horizontal loading bar that fills from left to right at the bottom of the screen. The incoming video should then fade in with a subtle scale-up effect from 0.95 to 1.0, creating a smooth application launch feel. Use a BaseLayout container with the loading bar as a ShapeAtom that animates its width from 0 to 100% during the transition overlap period.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout duration = video1.duration + video2.duration - 0.8s overlap. Outgoing VideoAtom: scale effect from 1 to 0.3, translate to bottom-right (translateX: 40%, translateY: 40%), opacity 1 to 0. Loading bar ShapeAtom: positioned at bottom (bottom-4), height-1, bg-blue-500, width animates from 0 to w-full over 0.8s. Incoming VideoAtom: starts at video1.duration - 0.8s, scale from 0.95 to 1, opacity 0 to 1. All effects use provider mode with targetIds. Z-index: loading bar (z-50), incoming (z-20), outgoing (z-10).

prompts.prompt: Design a glitch-style window corruption transition that mimics a system crash with loading recovery. The outgoing video should experience increasing digital artifacts - apply a shake effect that intensifies (1px to 8px amplitude), combined with RGB channel separation using CSS filters (increasing hue-rotate from 0 to 180deg). Add random opacity flickers (opacity alternating between 1 and 0.3) during the last 0.5 seconds. Display a terminal-style loading text overlay that types out 'LOADING...' character by character. The incoming video slides in from the left with a digital scan line effect (horizontal lines moving vertically). Create this using multiple overlapping semi-transparent ShapeAtoms for the scan lines.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 1.2s overlap period. Outgoing VideoAtom: shake effect with AnimationRange[] for x/y transforms (random values between -8 and 8), filter effect with hue-rotate animation, opacity flicker using stepped keyframes. Loading TextAtom: fixed position (top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2), font-mono text-green-400, typewriter animation using clip-path or width animation. Scan lines: 3-5 ShapeAtoms with h-px bg-white/20, animated translateY from -100% to 200%. Incoming VideoAtom: translateX from -100% to 0, combined with opacity fade-in.

prompts.prompt: Build a macOS-style window close animation with a progress ring loader between videos. When transitioning out, the video should perform the iconic 'genie effect' - scale down vertically while maintaining width initially, then compress horizontally as it approaches the bottom, creating a swoosh motion path. During the transition, display a circular progress ring (using SVG or border animation) that fills clockwise. The incoming video should expand from the center with a spring-bounce easing, starting from scale 0 and overshooting to 1.05 before settling at 1.0. Add a subtle blur during the scaling for depth.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 1s overlap. Outgoing VideoAtom: complex transform animation - scaleY from 1 to 0.1 (first 60%), then scaleX from 1 to 0.1 (last 40%), translateY to 50%, custom bezier easing. Progress ring: ShapeAtom or SVG with rounded-full border-4 border-gray-300, pseudo-element for fill using conic-gradient or stroke-dasharray animation. Incoming VideoAtom: scale from 0 to 1.05 to 1 with spring easing (cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55)), filter blur from 4px to 0. Position all elements absolute within container.

prompts.prompt: Create a Windows-style taskbar loading transition where the outgoing video minimizes to a taskbar button position while a segmented loading bar fills up. The video should scale down and move to the bottom-left corner with a perspective transform that makes it appear to fall backwards into the screen. Show a segmented loading bar (like Windows update) with 5 segments that fill sequentially. The incoming video should slide up from the bottom with a fade-in, simulating an application opening from the taskbar. Add a subtle reflection effect under the loading bar for polish.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 0.9s overlap. Outgoing VideoAtom: perspective(1000px) rotateX(45deg) for 3D tilt, scale to 0.2, translate to bottom-left, opacity fade. Loading bar: 5 separate ShapeAtoms (w-1/5 h-2 bg-blue-500) with staggered opacity animations (0 to 1) at 0.18s intervals. Reflection: duplicate loading bar ShapeAtoms with transform scaleY(-1) opacity-30 and gradient mask. Incoming VideoAtom: translateY from 100% to 0, opacity 0 to 1, starting at 50% through overlap period.

prompts.prompt: Develop a retro CRT TV channel-switching transition with static noise and loading percentage counter. The outgoing video should distort with horizontal scan lines and chromatic aberration (RGB split effect), then collapse vertically into a white line (like turning off an old CRT). Display static noise briefly using a rapidly changing noise pattern (could use multiple ImageAtoms with noise textures). Show a digital percentage counter that counts from 0% to 100% during loading. The incoming video should expand from a horizontal line with initial static interference that clears up.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 1.1s overlap. Outgoing VideoAtom: scaleY from 1 to 0.01 with ease-in, RGB split using multiple VideoAtoms with slight offset and red/green/blue filters. Static noise: 3-4 ImageAtoms with grayscale noise textures, rapid opacity cycling. Counter TextAtom: font-mono text-4xl, animate content using multiple TextAtoms with different percentages and opacity keyframes. Incoming VideoAtom: scaleY from 0.01 to 1, initial filter for static (contrast/brightness animation), clears after 0.3s.

prompts.prompt: Design a futuristic holographic window transition with a circular loading interface. The outgoing video should fragment into triangular shards that disperse outwards (simulate with multiple masked copies of the video using clip-path polygons). During transition, show a hi-tech circular loading interface with rotating arcs and a percentage display in the center. The incoming video materializes through a radial wipe effect from the center, with digital grid lines that fade away. Add glowing edges and particle effects for a sci-fi aesthetic.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 1.3s overlap. Fragmentation: 6-8 VideoAtom copies with different clip-path polygon() values, each with unique transform animations (translate and rotate). Circular loader: ShapeAtom with border rings, animate rotation (0 to 360deg), nested TextAtom for percentage. Radial wipe: incoming VideoAtom with radial-gradient mask animating from center. Grid overlay: ShapeAtoms creating grid pattern with opacity fade. Glow effects: box-shadow animations with neon colors (shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,255,255,0.5)]).

prompts.prompt: Build a mobile app-style transition with a pull-to-refresh loading spinner between videos. The outgoing video should slide up and fade out as if scrolling past it, with a subtle parallax effect (slower movement in background areas). Display a material design circular spinner that rotates continuously during the transition. The incoming video should slide up from below with a bounce effect at the end, simulating the elastic scroll behavior of mobile apps. Add a subtle drop shadow that grows as the new video slides in.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 0.7s overlap. Outgoing VideoAtom: translateY to -30% (not -100% for parallax feel), opacity 1 to 0, ease-out timing. Spinner: ShapeAtom with border-4 border-t-transparent rounded-full, continuous rotation animation. Incoming VideoAtom: translateY from 100% to 0 with overshoot to -5% then back to 0 (bounce), shadow-lg that animates from shadow-none. Container uses overflow-hidden for clean edges.

prompts.prompt: Create a video game menu transition with a loading progress bar that fills based on 'XP points'. The outgoing video should pixelate progressively (use multiple overlaid versions with increasing blur and scale) while sliding left. Show a game-style XP bar with animated fill, including particle effects when milestones are reached (25%, 50%, 75%, 100%). The incoming video should assemble from pixels, starting highly pixelated and becoming clear, while sliding in from the right. Add coin or star collection sound effect visual indicators.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 1s overlap. Pixelation: 3 VideoAtom layers with increasing filter blur (0, 4px, 8px) and scale (1, 1.2, 1.5), staggered opacity. XP bar: ShapeAtom container with inner ShapeAtom fill (bg-gradient-to-r from-yellow-400 to-yellow-600), width animates 0 to 100%. Particle bursts: small ShapeAtoms that scale and fade at milestone points. Incoming VideoAtom: initial filter blur(8px), animates to blur(0), translateX from 100% to 0.

prompts.prompt: Develop a streaming platform buffering transition that mimics video quality adaptation. The outgoing video should progressively decrease in quality (blur and pixelation effects) before freezing and fading out. Display a modern streaming buffer animation - three dots that bounce in sequence, with a 'Loading HD' text indicator. The incoming video should start at low quality (blurred) and progressively sharpen to full HD, simulating adaptive bitrate streaming. Include a quality indicator badge that shows resolution stepping up (360p → 720p → 1080p).
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 0.8s overlap. Quality degradation: outgoing VideoAtom with filter blur animating 0 to 12px, add pixelation using image-rendering CSS. Buffering dots: 3 ShapeAtoms (w-3 h-3 rounded-full) with staggered translateY animations creating bounce effect. Quality badges: TextAtom sequence with different resolution labels, opacity transitions between them. Incoming VideoAtom: filter blur from 12px to 0 in steps (12px for 0.2s, 6px for 0.2s, 0px), simulating quality improvement.

prompts.prompt: Design a split-screen wipe transition with a loading meter that moves across the divide. The outgoing video should be revealed to be 'behind' the incoming video through a vertical wipe that moves from left to right. At the wipe edge, show a vertical loading meter that fills from bottom to top as it travels across the screen. The incoming video should have a subtle 3D perspective tilt that flattens as the wipe completes. Add a glass morphism effect at the wipe edge for a premium feel.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 1.2s overlap. Wipe effect: incoming VideoAtom with clip-path polygon animating from polygon(0 0, 0 0, 0 100%, 0 100%) to polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%). Loading meter: ShapeAtom (w-1 h-full) that translates horizontally in sync with wipe, contains inner ShapeAtom that animates height from 0 to 100%. Glass morphism: additional ShapeAtom at wipe edge with backdrop-blur-sm bg-white/10. 3D tilt: incoming video starts with transform perspective(1000px) rotateY(-5deg), animates to rotateY(0deg).
